_doc: Recorded display ICC profiles per claimed OS (display_profile.py). Each entry: name, w (weight), icc (base64, reduced to the tags qcms reads by scripts/reduce-icc-profile.py), source (machine and how it was recorded), and screens: the native device-pixel resolutions of the panel the profile belongs to; an entry without screens is the OS default. Only profiles recorded on real machines go here (GetICMProfileW on Windows). An OS with no entries keeps the browser's built-in sRGB.
